profileHash: sha256 of canonical JSON (sorted object keys, no whitespace)
rule: One exact package progresses only through ordered append-only prefixes. Foundation requires non-vacuous exact-head review validation; cutover retains provider-neutral not-enforced-before and enforced-after observations with strict chronology; closure reuses completion-evidence validation and exactly reconciles the package version plus manifest, lockfile, install, invocation, duplicate-removal, and rollback references. Foundation, canary, and cutover are phase-local readiness only; activation and closure are distinct. A repository profile is stable structural context, never an adoption state machine.
